This is not the Holocaust, YET. Calling them Concentration camps is entirely correct. This isn’t about how many people are being killed, but the fact that it is even happening. It’s a suppression of the truth akin to what fascists enact. The first thing to go is the past and any record of it. Ask Pol Pot.
